_source: Fight facts from the HockeyFights.com 2026-27 regular season fight log (fan votes and ratings as read 2026-10-14); ownership from ESPN league 1867179300 rosters read 2026-10-14. Video links are the YouTube clips embedded on each HockeyFights fight page.

fightOfTheWeek.title: Frederic vs. McBain: Lunch Served in Utah
fightOfTheWeek.vote: Frederic 73%, McBain 16%, Draw 11% - rated 7.6 on 81 votes
fightOfTheWeek.shoresy: Frederic caught him a minute into warmups, fed him four rights, took the card 73 to 16, and the 11% who called it a draw were watching the zamboni. Best part? Both tough guys are on fantasy rosters, so the Bedards banked a beating and Something's Bruin paid for one. Chirp rating: eight out of ten. Two minutes to Something's Bruin for sending a centreman to do laundry he could not fold.
fightOfTheWeek.goon: Heck of a scrap for the first period, fellas. Trent threw them hard and honest, and Jack stood in and took it, which takes more guts than throwing. That is one tilt each for the Bedards and the Bruin boys, one knuckle apiece. Sorry about the laundry line. Shoresy gets excited.

undercard.title: Nikita Zadorov vs. Darnell Nurse
undercard.line: Zadorov took it 93% to 3% in Boston - and both heavyweights cash for Something's Bruin, so one roster threw a major at itself and still got paid.
undercard.shoresy: One roster, two fighters, zero self-preservation. Something's Bruin watched his own defencemen drop the mitts on each other and logged it as depth scoring. Ten out of ten, you cannot coach that.

undercard.title: Declan Carlile vs. Jeremy Lauzon
undercard.line: Carlile answered the bell in Vegas and the card could not pick a winner - Lauzon 43%, Draw 43%, Carlile 13%. Both are rostered: Carlile for Team Tenis, Lauzon for Anger issues inc.
undercard.shoresy: A 43-43 split decision is just a hug with extra steps, boys. Four out of ten. Two minutes each for wasting my tape.

tapeRoom.title: The Brawl in Hockeytown
tapeRoom.game: Colorado Avalanche at Detroit Red Wings, Joe Louis Arena
tapeRoom.line: Darren McCarty went after Claude Lemieux, both goalies, Patrick Roy and Mike Vernon, met at centre ice, and Detroit won it in overtime on a McCarty goal. The rivalry every rivalry since has been measured against.
tapeRoom.goon: Two goalies fighting. That's when you know a building means it. Respect to everybody in it.

tapeRoom.title: Iginla vs. Lecavalier
tapeRoom.game: Stanley Cup Final, Game 3, Tampa Bay at Calgary
tapeRoom.line: Two captains, two franchise players, the Cup on the line, and they dropped the gloves anyway. Stars do not fight. These two did.
tapeRoom.goon: That's the one I show kids. Captains standing up for their rooms. No cheap stuff. Beautiful.

tapeRoom.title: Probert vs. Domi
tapeRoom.game: Detroit Red Wings at New York Rangers, Madison Square Garden
tapeRoom.line: The rematch. Earlier that year Domi had skated off with an imaginary championship belt. This time they went seconds after the opening faceoff, and the Garden stood up for it.
tapeRoom.goon: Two heavyweights who both said yes. That's the whole code right there, bud.

tapeRoom.title: Three Fights Off The Opening Faceoff
tapeRoom.game: New Jersey Devils at New York Rangers
tapeRoom.line: The puck dropped and three fights started at once: Ryan Carter and Stu Bickel, Cam Janssen and Brandon Prust, Eric Boulton and Mike Rupp. John Tortorella and Peter DeBoer kept yelling at each other from the benches.
tapeRoom.goon: Zero seconds played and six guys in the box. Now that's a warm-up.

tapeRoom.title: Reaves vs. Rempe
tapeRoom.game: San Jose Sharks at New York Rangers
tapeRoom.line: The veteran heavyweight and the six-foot-eight kid, second season in a row. Ryan Reaves is on Goontown Gaitors' roster in this league.
tapeRoom.goon: Old guy teaching the young guy, and the young guy listening. That's how it's supposed to go.

tapeRoom.title: Zadorov vs. Joshua
tapeRoom.game: Toronto Maple Leafs vs. Boston Bruins
tapeRoom.line: Nikita Zadorov, the man who led the NHL in penalty minutes, and Dakota Joshua. Zadorov is on Something's Bruin's blue line in this league.
tapeRoom.goon: Big man, big reach, fights fair. Something's Bruin, you drafted a good one. Sorry to Joshua.

tapeRoom.title: Laraque vs. Ivanans
tapeRoom.game: Los Angeles Kings vs. Phoenix Coyotes
tapeRoom.line: Georges Laraque, wearing a microphone, asks Raitis Ivanans if he wants to go, then wishes him good luck before the first punch. The politest heavyweight fight ever caught on tape, and the whole code in one sentence.
tapeRoom.goon: This is the one, bud. Ask the man. Wish him luck. Then do your job. If you fellas set your lineups half as honest as that, I would have nothing to apologize for all year.

tapeRoomNote: Old fights are uploaded by fans and come and go. If a link dies, the date and the teams will find you another copy.

hatTrickWatch.title: Gordie Howe hat trick watch
hatTrickWatch.note: A goal, an assist and a fight in one NHL game, by anybody rostered in this league. Checked every week against the box scores.
hatTrickWatch.empty: Nobody yet. The season's barely started. Somebody on the Carter Hart Hate Club will get there first and then never shut up about it.
